artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2020 and 2021, GE continues to emphasize artificial_intelligence and manufacturing as core risk exposure (2020 para 21; 2021 para 37). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in artificial_intelligence, while the later filing adds clearer weight to manufacturing (2020 para 5; 2021 para 19). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2020 para 21; 2021 para 19). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2020 para 5; 2021 para 37). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2020 para 21; 2021 para 37).
